svg.title: A centered average smooths neighboring observations
svg.desc: Line chart of Closing price in $ against Date. Closing price view is limited to 37 through 61 in source axis units; summary statistics describe retained data, which may extend beyond this view. N = 1 per point. Values run from 39.5 to 57.3. The mean is 49. Simulated data. No real company is depicted.
